modshift.confirm.text: %s files (%s) will be downloaded and %s files removed. Then the game closes and your mods folder is updated. Old files are kept in %s. Start the game again afterwards.

modshift.ignore.tip: ModShift will not offer updates for this mod again. You can undo this in Settings.
modshift.noChangelog: No changelog was written for this version.
